title: Pascu-ucks
summary: Pascu-ucks is connected with a creek on the island historically called Screcunkas, now associated with Cedar Island in Babylon's Great South Bay.
map_geometry_source: Approximate modern Cedar Island / Screcunkas point based on Tooker entry for Pascu-ucks; not an exact historical creek coordinate.
history_content: The name belongs to a marsh-and-creek landscape on the western Great South Bay. Context appear in the historic moments below.
translation_content:
The name is interpreted as a turning or dividing place, connected with land or place language. The form is also compared with Patchogue for related word structure.

Why Place Names Matter

“Officially registered place names demonstrate what we, as a society, value both from our history and in our future.”

— Dr Samantha Wells, Chairperson, Place Names Committee, Engagement Framework: Place Naming in the Northern Territory (2022), PDF page 3, committee preamble
whereintheworld_content: Approximate/general point near Cedar Island in the Town of Babylon, used only to place the historical creek-name landscape on the map. This is not an exact historical creek coordinate.
